basis: The condition bars work at night and on Sundays through the village section. That does not change how fast a rig drills on a day it is working, so it does not belong in the production rate — it removes working days from the calendar. The calendar-to-work-day ratio is where the app already puts weather for the same reason. 1.35 is close to the slowest of the three as-built projects (1.36) and is a judgement about how much of the works falls in the restricted section, not a measurement.
